name: Bonn peoples panel on climate change
content: Background History and Context Bonn4Future is the citizen participation process for the Council decision for Bonn to be climate-neutral by 2035 at the latest. Together, Bonn citizens, various (civil) social actors, politics, administration and science are looking for an answer to how climate neutrality can succeed in Bonn. Bonn4Future was promoted by Bonn in Transition, the Bonn climate guard and many organizations and initiatives created by Bonn. In September 2020, the City Council of Bonn Majority and support of almost all parties decided "Bonn4Future - We for the climate! to promote. Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities Bonn Municipal City council Participant Recruitment and Selection 100 citizens were randomly drawn from the register of the residents' registration office in advance in order to get very different perspectives together.In addition, organizations and groups could express interest in participating if they bring important societal perspectives to the table.25 of them were then selected according to fixed criteria.
